description: This file defines the StructField class used in Spark SQL to represent a field within a StructType, including metadata handling, JSON serialization, and SQL/DDL string generation.

classes.name: StructField
classes.description: Represents a field within a Spark SQL StructType, including metadata, data type, nullability, and methods for serialization, comparison, and SQL representation.

methods.name: buildFormattedString
methods.description: Builds a formatted string representation of the StructField and its data type for debugging or display.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a legacy-compatible string representation of the StructField.

methods.name: jsonValue
methods.description: Serializes the StructField to a JSON value.

methods.name: dataTypeJsonValue
methods.description: Serializes the data type of the StructField to JSON, removing collation info for compatibility.

methods.name: metadataJson
methods.description: Serializes the metadata of the StructField to JSON, including collation metadata if present.

methods.name: withComment
methods.description: Returns a new StructField with an updated comment in metadata.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment from the StructField's metadata, if any.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default value for a function parameter, if specified in metadata.

methods.name: withCurrentDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets a new current default value in the StructField's metadata.

methods.name: clearCurrentDefaultValue
methods.description: Removes the current default value from the StructField's metadata.

methods.name: getCurrentDefaultValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current default value of the StructField, if any.

methods.name: withExistenceDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets an existence default value in the StructField's metadata.

methods.name: getExistenceDefaultValue
methods.description: Retrieves the existence default value, if any.

methods.name: hasExistenceDefaultValue
methods.description: Checks if an existence default value is set.

methods.name: getDDLDefault
methods.description: Constructs the default value part of the DDL string.

methods.name: getDDLComment
methods.description: Constructs the comment part of the DDL string.

methods.name: sql
methods.description: Returns a schema string in SQL format for the StructField.

methods.name: toDDL
methods.description: Returns a schema string in DDL format for the StructField.
